answer: Imagine a harbor where every new agent must moor beside an established vessel before its cargo is trusted. Each sponsor signs a bond of its own funds, so a dock crowded with fake boats would sink the very captains who vouched for them. One false identity sends a ripple of losses back through its guarantor's ledger, making bulk registration a losing trade. Over seasons the economy grows like an orchard: only trees planted and tended by accountable owners bear harvestable fruit, while anonymous seedlings are pruned away.
